toolDefinitions.name: databases-inspect
toolDefinitions.description: Show the name, revision, tables and columns of a database.

resourceId.description: ID of the database, as the person gave it or as returned by a database creation.

toolDefinitions.name: rows-query
toolDefinitions.description: Select rows of one table with an optional filter, sort and page size. Pass the returned cursor to read the next page.

resourceId.description: ID of the database, as the person gave it or as returned by a database creation.

table.description: Table name as it is labelled in the database.

columns.description: Column labels to return. Empty returns all columns.

filter.description: Row filter. A node is exactly one of: {"and":[nodes]}, {"or":[nodes]} or a leaf {"column":label,"op":op,"value":v} with op eq, ne, lt, lte, gt, gte, contains, starts-with, ends-with, or {"column":label,"op":"in","values":[v]}, or op is-null and is-not-null with no value.

cursor.description: Cursor returned by the previous page.

toolDefinitions.name: rows-aggregate
toolDefinitions.description: Count, sum, avg, min or max over the rows a filter selects, with an optional group-by column.

resourceId.description: ID of the database, as the person gave it or as returned by a database creation.

table.description: Table name as it is labelled in the database.

filter.description: Row filter. A node is exactly one of: {"and":[nodes]}, {"or":[nodes]} or a leaf {"column":label,"op":op,"value":v} with op eq, ne, lt, lte, gt, gte, contains, starts-with, ends-with, or {"column":label,"op":"in","values":[v]}, or op is-null and is-not-null with no value.

toolDefinitions.name: rows-export
toolDefinitions.description: Export the rows of one table, with an optional filter and sort, to a CSV file for the person to download. The result is a private file with a name, size and expiry; the rows themselves are not returned. Use rows-query to read rows.

resourceId.description: ID of the database, as the person gave it or as returned by a database creation.

table.description: Table name as it is labelled in the database.

columns.description: Column labels to export, in order. Empty exports all columns. "_id" adds the row ID.

filter.description: Row filter. A node is exactly one of: {"and":[nodes]}, {"or":[nodes]} or a leaf {"column":label,"op":op,"value":v} with op eq, ne, lt, lte, gt, gte, contains, starts-with, ends-with, or {"column":label,"op":"in","values":[v]}, or op is-null and is-not-null with no value.

maxRows.description: Most rows to export. Empty exports every row up to the export limit; past the limit nothing is exported.

toolDefinitions.name: databases-create
toolDefinitions.description: Create a new database with the given name. In a chat it runs at once and the person can undo it; from an API key it is only a proposal that a person confirms.

toolDefinitions.name: databases-rename
toolDefinitions.description: Propose a new name for a database. Needs the owner role and a person's confirmation outside a chat. In a chat it applies at once and the person can undo it.

resourceId.description: ID of the database, as the person gave it or as returned by a database creation.

toolDefinitions.name: tables-create
toolDefinitions.description: Propose a new empty table. Needs the owner role and a person's confirmation outside a chat. In a chat it applies at once and the person can undo it.

resourceId.description: ID of the database, as the person gave it or as returned by a database creation.

table.description: Table name as it is labelled in the database.

toolDefinitions.name: tables-rename
toolDefinitions.description: Propose a new name for a table. Needs the owner role and a person's confirmation outside a chat. In a chat it applies at once and the person can undo it.

resourceId.description: ID of the database, as the person gave it or as returned by a database creation.

table.description: Table name as it is labelled in the database.

toolDefinitions.name: tables-drop
toolDefinitions.description: Propose dropping a table and all of its rows. Needs the owner role and a person's confirmation outside a chat. In a chat it applies at once and the person can undo it.

resourceId.description: ID of the database, as the person gave it or as returned by a database creation.

table.description: Table name as it is labelled in the database.

toolDefinitions.name: columns-add
toolDefinitions.description: Propose a new column. Needs the owner role and a person's confirmation outside a chat. In a chat it applies at once and the person can undo it.

resourceId.description: ID of the database, as the person gave it or as returned by a database creation.

table.description: Table name as it is labelled in the database.

default.description: Default value of the column, a JSON literal of the column type.

toolDefinitions.name: columns-rename
toolDefinitions.description: Propose a new label for a column. Needs the owner role and a person's confirmation outside a chat. In a chat it applies at once and the person can undo it.

resourceId.description: ID of the database, as the person gave it or as returned by a database creation.

table.description: Table name as it is labelled in the database.

toolDefinitions.name: columns-drop
toolDefinitions.description: Propose dropping a column and its values. Needs the owner role and a person's confirmation outside a chat. In a chat it applies at once and the person can undo it.

resourceId.description: ID of the database, as the person gave it or as returned by a database creation.

table.description: Table name as it is labelled in the database.

toolDefinitions.name: rows-insert
toolDefinitions.description: Propose inserting 1 to 100 rows. Each row maps column labels to values. Needs the editor role and a person's confirmation outside a chat. In a chat it applies at once and the person can undo it.

resourceId.description: ID of the database, as the person gave it or as returned by a database creation.

table.description: Table name as it is labelled in the database.

rows.description: Rows to insert: objects of column label to value.

toolDefinitions.name: rows-update
toolDefinitions.description: Propose setting column values on rows named by ids or a filter. Needs the editor role and a person's confirmation outside a chat. In a chat it applies at once and the person can undo it.

resourceId.description: ID of the database, as the person gave it or as returned by a database creation.

table.description: Table name as it is labelled in the database.

filter.description: Row filter. A node is exactly one of: {"and":[nodes]}, {"or":[nodes]} or a leaf {"column":label,"op":op,"value":v} with op eq, ne, lt, lte, gt, gte, contains, starts-with, ends-with, or {"column":label,"op":"in","values":[v]}, or op is-null and is-not-null with no value.

toolDefinitions.name: rows-delete
toolDefinitions.description: Propose deleting rows named by ids or a filter. Needs the editor role and a person's confirmation outside a chat. In a chat it applies at once and the person can undo it.

resourceId.description: ID of the database, as the person gave it or as returned by a database creation.

table.description: Table name as it is labelled in the database.

filter.description: Row filter. A node is exactly one of: {"and":[nodes]}, {"or":[nodes]} or a leaf {"column":label,"op":op,"value":v} with op eq, ne, lt, lte, gt, gte, contains, starts-with, ends-with, or {"column":label,"op":"in","values":[v]}, or op is-null and is-not-null with no value.
